title: 生命保険商品一覧｜アクサ生命保険株式会社

blocks.name: breadcrumbs
blocks.description: Use it to show the page location trail on content pages. Used on 8 pages (content, insurance-guide, customer-hub, product-listing and prospect-hub templates).

blocks.name: page-banner
blocks.description: Use at the top of a page to show the page title, optionally with a background image and a side login or CTA box. Used on 3 pages (customer-hub, product-listing and prospect-hub templates).

blocks.name: section-title
blocks.description: Use it to introduce a page section with a styled heading. Used on 4 pages (insurance-guide, homepage, product-listing and prospect-hub templates).

blocks.name: anchor-links
blocks.description: Use it for in-page navigation buttons that jump to sections further down the page. Used on 6 pages (content, product-listing and prospect-hub templates).

blocks.name: link-buttons
blocks.description: Use it for a set of navigation links shown as arrow buttons, such as contractor procedures or product category links. Used on 2 pages (customer-hub and product-listing templates).

blocks.name: accordion
blocks.description: Use it for FAQ-style or grouped content that readers expand panel by panel. Used on 2 pages (insurance-guide and product-listing templates).

blocks.name: simulation-quiz
blocks.description: Use it to let visitors answer a few questions and get a recommended insurance product. Used on 3 pages (homepage, product-listing and prospect-hub templates).

blocks.name: cta-consult
blocks.description: Use it at the end of a page to invite visitors to book a consultation, request a brochure or call. Used on 2 pages (homepage and product-listing templates).

blocks.name: contact-links
blocks.description: Use to present phone contact points with hours and a contact CTA, plus related banners or links. Used on 3 pages (insurance-guide, customer-hub and product-listing templates).
